_note: Narration for ConnectraV3Sound. `start` is the absolute frame (60fps) in ConnectraV3. `text` may use misaki phoneme overrides [word](/IPA/) for Kokoro; scripts strip them to plain text for other engines.

lines.text: Ten machines. Ten terminals. And only one of you.
Install [Connectra](/kənˈɛktɹə/) on each machine. Sign in once, and every device connects, outbound.
Now one chat reaches all of them. The agent lists your devices, then runs the update on each one.
It works with any [MCP](/ˌɛmsˌiˈpi/) client. Your web assistant, your [IDE](/ˌaɪdˌiˈi/), your terminal.
For [AI](/ˌeɪˈaɪ/) builders, infra teams, developers, and anyone with a phone.
The cloud can ask. Your machine decides.
Every agent. Every device. Connected by [Connectra](/kənˈɛktɹə/).
